headline: Mooring County Erupts Anew as Olavis Wake Flares
war_summary: Three hours further into the ledger, Mooring County has displaced all else: fifty-six base actions within a day, the latest recorded at this edition's closing, have left one Warden hold of the previous report in ruin, the county now standing nine Warden to two Colonial, Gravekeeper's Holdfast its stormiest post and casualty returns running above two thousand an hour. In the Weathered Expanse the Colonials have recovered two posts from no-man's-land, the count now six to one with two demolished; Wightwalk remains the busiest ground and Warden losses still outpace. Callahan's Passage, storm-torn at our last edition, has fallen silent, yet stands wholly in Warden keeping. The Nevish Line's seven-to-one footing is unchanged, though its casualty tallies swell by the hour. A fresh fire burns at Olavis Wake, where upward of sixteen hundred casualties fell in two hours around Koskinla and one post lies in no-man's-land. In Marban Hollow, Checkpoint Bua took repeated blows as this edition closed, the hollow standing six Colonial to one Warden. Day 556; the demand of thirty-four victory towns stands unmet and no victor is named.
